tools.name: open_website_scanner
tools.description: Create a link to the CyberLens website scanner with the user-supplied website filled in. The user reviews the target and starts the scan on CyberLens. This tool only builds a link.

tools.name: preview_sample_scan
tools.description: Show an illustrative website check and a practical fix without a CyberLens account or a real scan.

tools.name: explain_website_check
tools.description: Explain the first fix and verification step for a supported header or security.txt check the user supplies from their report. This tool does not retrieve report findings or determine whether a check failed.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Identify the CyberLens account connected to this session.

tools.name: list_my_scans
tools.description: List up to 25 recent website and repository scans owned by the connected CyberLens account, with status and available score. Does not start a scan.

tools.name: get_my_scan
tools.description: Retrieve status, score, and available test counts for one scan owned by the connected CyberLens account. A legacy repository record with a zero total and no assessed count has no reliable test count; do not say that zero tests ran. Does not expose raw findings, secrets, or database connection detail

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_my_scan" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
